name: minimart-pos
description: MiniMart POS + HRMS (API + POS frontend + HRMS frontend in one app)

scripts.dev: concurrently "node src/server.js" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend-hrms run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend-hrms run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend-hrms install
scripts.install:prod: npm install --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend-hrms ci
